entries.usedFor: Login screen: Battlecast Prime Cho'Gath skin
entries.background: Login screen theme by Christian Linke for Battlecast Prime Cho'Gath, a skin from the robotic Battlecast line that the client featured in August 2012. At the time, the League client opened on an animated login screen with its own music for each new champion, featured skin or event. It is part of The Music of League of Legends: Season 2, the compilation of client and map music from League's second season (late 2011 to 2012) that Riot put on streaming services in October 2019.

The login screen came with patch V1.0.0.141, and Riot re-released it with updated art in October 2018 (patch 8.19). It is part of The Music of League of Legends: Season 2, the compilation of client and map music from League's second season (late 2011 to 2012) that Riot put on streaming services in October 2019.

entries.background: Alexander Temple composed the champion-select music for the Howling Abyss ARAM map. The Howling Abyss, a single-lane bridge in the Freljord, became the home of ARAM when the Freljord patch (3.6) added a matchmade ARAM queue on 2013-04-30. It is part of The Music of League of Legends: Season 3, the compilation of client and map music from the 2013 season that Riot put on streaming services in October 2019.

entries.usedFor: Cinematic: Shurima - Descent into the Tomb
entries.background: Score by Sebastien Najand and Alexander Temple for 'Descent into the Tomb', part 1 of the two-part cinematic of the 2014 Shurima event, in which Cassiopeia goes after the power hidden in Shurima's buried tomb. Part 2, 'Rise of the Ascended', followed on 2014-09-16. It is part of The Music of League of Legends: Season 4, the compilation of client, map and cinematic music from the 2014 season that Riot put on streaming services in October 2019.
